nodes.text:
Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a respiratory virus 🦠 that belongs to the Paramyxoviridae family, closely related to respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). It was first identified in 2001 and is now recognized as a common cause of respiratory infections worldwide.
